text: A single digit decodes if it's 1–9. Two digits decode if they form 10–26.
dp[i] = number of ways to decode s[0..i−1]. At each position, check one-digit and two-digit decodings separately.
Leading zeros are invalid: '06' is NOT a valid encoding of F. Guard against s[i] === '0' for single-digit, and s[i..i+1] outside 10–26 for two-digit.
